title: Explicit source-fixed native gate cgroup preparation
$comment: Selection only, not process evidence or Reserve authority. The source-owned producer creates one fresh root-owned /sys/fs/cgroup/serverware-native-gate leaf on a genuinely verified cgroup2 hierarchy and attaches only the gate after child creation under the original Prepared/deadline. No path, PID, UID, supplied hash, descriptor, fallback, reuse, delegation or lifetime extension is accepted. Actual expected /proc cgroup bytes are 0::/serverware-native-gate followed by LF; independent client assignments must pin the hash of those exact bytes. Kernel/mount support is not established by this schema.
